name: hyagent
description: Agent-Native OA — 對話式表單填寫 Agent（monorepo：server + client + shared）

scripts.dev:mcp: npm run dev -w mcp/kit && npm run dev -w mcp/store-demo
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w ui && npm run typecheck -w sdk && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w admin && npm run typecheck -w mcp/kit && npm run typecheck -w mcp/store-demo && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w admin && npm run test -w client && npm run test -w sdk && npm run test -w mcp/kit && npm run test -w mcp/store-demo && npm --prefix mobile test
